entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: First an old castle, then a museum, and[n]now a bank? This is some exciting shit,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Our third Palace, huh? I feel like we're[n]really gettin' the hang of this stuff!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All the dough we've seen in here...[n]I can't even imagine how many people[n]they've ripped off over the years.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I got no idea what Kaneshiro's doin'[n]over there, but now's the time to[n]get him!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, he sure can run... Let's go[n]after him, Joker!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't no way we can check all of these...[n]I sure hope Queen's right about this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look at all this shit—money everywhere...[n]There basically ain't anything else here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugggh, another set of codes! I'm so bad[n]at this kinda shit...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Gahhh, all these codes are just too damn[n]confusin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man you're really something, solvin'[n]those codes like they ain't nothin'[n]at all...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I got no idea where Kaneshiro went, but[n]it don't matter so long as we just steal[n]what we came for!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Man, that dog-like Shadow... I bet its[n]nose is gonna be a real pain for us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Queen's analysis skills are pretty good—[n]Uh, almost as good as mine, I mean!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I know I'm not gonna be one of those[n]people who lets money control their lives[n]when I get turned back into a human.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Careful, guys! We've spotted another[n]security guard...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The elevator'll probably take us down[n]to the sub-levels. Keep your guard[n]up, guys!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll just have to trust Queen with her[n]idea. Let's go, Joker.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Being down in the dumps isn't going[n]to solve anything... Let's look around[n]for anything that might help us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What? Can I crack the code for you? Well,[n]uhhhh, of course I can! I mean, heh, you[n]didn't think it'd be tough for me, did you?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've unlocked the third lock![n]We're even closer to the treasure![n]...I assume!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Queen was right on the money![n]I expected nothing less from the[n]brain of the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let us know when it's time to move out.[n]Make sure you're as ready as possible.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I always knew Skull would be fine[n]getting bossed around by a girl, but[n]Mona's the exact same way, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This place's security is the tightest[n]we've ever seen—but, being a bank[n]and all, I guess that makes sense.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He acts like he does all the work to rake[n]in the cash, but it's just getting handed[n]over by his lackeys. What a joke!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That elevator over by Kaneshiro...[n]I wonder where it goes?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's keeping ya? Let's get in that[n]elevator!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Nothing but vaults everywhere we go...[n]I think I'm starting to get mixed-up[n]in here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Any more notes lying around here?[n]Or maybe they're really well-hidden.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "Anyone who can't earn money is[n]worthless," huh? I feel kinda bad[n]for the people he's told that...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Another code? Are you any good at these,[n]Joker?
It'll be a cakewalk.
It might be tough.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Awesome! We're counting on you, Joker!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I hear ya there... Let's take a good look[n]at that note.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What could be Kaneshiro's treasure?[n]Maybe it's just even more money...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Did you take care of everything you[n]needed to? Let's make sure we're as[n]ready as possible.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In all honesty, I thought "Rider" would[n]have made for a rather suitable name...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Not only is security tight, but the floor[n]layout is rather complicated. Let's be[n]sure to proceed with caution.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Imagine the art supplies I could purchase[n]with the money flying around here—were[n]I willing to touch such ill-gotten funds.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We'll need to draw a little closer to[n]be able to hear their exchange.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: While I am curious about the code,[n]we need to continue on for now.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hmm, Queen appears to have an idea...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Moving the vault itself? How intriguing...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A golden pig, eh? Not only is it a[n]piggy bank, but it's a rather accurate[n]representation of Kaneshiro's issues.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: For someone claiming to aim for great[n]heights, he does seem rather cowardly...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It took us no small effort, but our[n]path is finally clear.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, we must still prepare the[n]calling card. I hope you all look forward[n]to what I produce.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The way that entrance is blocked...[n]I think I'd call that overkill, at the[n]very least...
That was so cool back there.
You're a real speed demon.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh, you think so? Thank you!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, well... It just sort of felt like[n]second nature to me...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There seem to be a great deal of[n]security cameras... It may be best[n]not to wander around blindly.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He's taking advantage of these people[n]and he can't even treat them like[n]human beings! We have to stop him!
That's the spirit.
Let's change his heart.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah, I've got a lesson to teach him!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Just looking at his face makes me mad.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Looks like he got away... Let's find him[n]when we're ready.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He should be the last thing between us[n]and the treasure.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We probably won't need to check[n]every single one of these vaults.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Just as I thought—the way those vaults[n]moved... No, I oughtn't jump to any[n]conclusions just yet.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At this point, the only way I can describe[n]Kaneshiro is "pathetic."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I cannot let this continue when one of[n]our own students is a victim here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If my deductions are correct, that[n]should've been the last one. Let's[n]press on, Joker.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So we're going to send the calling card?[n]I suppose I truly am a phantom thief[n]now...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Sinner who is tied to the chains of fate...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You must not dawdle in the real world.[n]Return to your cell and find the strength[n]to resist.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Your must continue to resist in order[n]to change your fate...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Heehee! Do you really have the time[n]to fool around?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Get back in the pokey and challenge[n]your fate!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Give it all you got! Your future depends[n]on it!
